deviations_from_spec: bpmn-js-properties-panel npm package NOT added — a custom React panel was built instead. Rationale: (1) the @bpmn-io/properties-panel API requires bpmn-moddle descriptors for custom properties, adding non-trivial setup; (2) the existing bpmn-theme.css already provides all bio-properties-panel-* CSS; (3) a custom panel gives tighter control over the executor-type dropdown and live recolor wiring. The DoD requirement 'If you add bpmn-js-properties-panel + @bpmn-io/properties-panel deps... that's fine' was an option, not a mandate.
create.task null return to suppress default: bpmn-js v17 merges provider entries by key — returning null removes a lower-priority provider's key. This is the supported override mechanism.
friction_events: FE-T0098-1: web/node_modules absent on fresh worktree — npm install ran before build.
FE-T0098-2: bpmn-js palette merging uses provider priority (1500 > default 1000) + null-return to suppress keys — verified in PaletteProvider.js source.
